evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and modifies MuHash3072 cryptographic primitive code in src/crypto/muhash.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an aliasing bug in a cryptographic primitive, but the problem is reasonably deferrable because no current callers trigger it. The author notes that 'x /= x actually leaves 1/D instead of the empty set', but confirms that 'No code in the node/index divides MuHash objects by themselves, so running nodes are not affected.'
